Advent
1st Sunday of Advent
Matthew 24:37-44
"Watch ye therefore, because you know not what hour your Lord will come." (Mt 24:42)
Stay Awake for Jesus
Jesus said, "Stay awake! Be ready!" In Noah's time, people did not get ready. We get ready for Jesus with love and prayer.

How can you get ready for Jesus?
Say a morning prayer; Light the Advent wreath; Help at home
Jesus, help me be ready for You. Amen.
Be Ready!

Jesus told His disciples to stay awake, because no one knows the day He will come again. In Noah's time, people ate and drank and did not notice the flood coming. Two people may be working side by side, and one is taken. Jesus wants us to be ready, like a servant who keeps watch all night. In Advent, we get our hearts ready with prayer and good deeds.

What is one thing you can change this Advent?
Pray before bed every night; Do a hidden kindness; Make an Advent plan
Lord Jesus, keep my heart awake and ready for You. Amen.

Advent
2nd Sunday of Advent
Matthew 3:1-12
"Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths." (Mt 3:3)
Prepare the Way
John the Baptist lived in the desert. He wore camel hair and ate locusts and honey. He said, "Get ready! Jesus is coming!"
John · desert · prepare · way
Prepare the way!

Jesus, help me make my heart ready. Amen.
A Voice in the Desert

John the Baptist preached in the desert of Judea, saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!" He wore camel hair and ate locusts and wild honey. Crowds came to the Jordan River to confess their sins and be baptized. John said, "Prepare the way of the Lord, make His paths straight." He told them that someone mightier was coming who would baptize with the Holy Spirit.
repent · baptize · prophet · desert · Isaiah · straight
Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths.
Straight Paths · Turn away from / Turn toward
What does it mean to repent?
What is one 'crooked path' in your life to make straight?
Go to Confession or make an examen; Forgive someone; Read Isaiah 40
Lord, make my heart a straight path for You. Amen.

3rd Sunday of Advent (Gaudete)
Matthew 11:2-11
"The blind see, the lame walk... the poor have the gospel preached to them." (Mt 11:5)
Jesus Brings Joy
John asked, "Jesus, are You the One?" Jesus said, "The blind see and the lame walk!" Good news makes us happy!
joy · see · heal · Jesus

Are You the One?

John the Baptist was in prison, and he sent his disciples to ask Jesus, "Are You the one who is to come?" Jesus answered, "Go and tell John what you hear and see." The blind see, the lame walk, lepers are made clean, and the poor hear good news. Jesus said John was the messenger sent to prepare His way. This Gaudete Sunday we rejoice, because the Savior is near!

How can your actions show you follow Jesus?
Visit or call someone lonely; Give to the poor; Tell someone good news
Jesus, let my life show others Your joy. Amen.

4th Sunday of Advent
Matthew 1:18-24
"...they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us." (Mt 1:23)
God With Us
An angel came to Joseph in a dream. He said, "Take Mary as your wife. Her Baby is from God!" Joseph obeyed.

Jesus, You are always with me. Amen.
Joseph's Yes

Mary was engaged to Joseph, and she was going to have a baby by the Holy Spirit. Joseph was a good man and did not want to shame her. An angel came to him in a dream and said, "Do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife." The angel said to name the baby Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins. Joseph woke up and did what the angel told him.

Where do you need God to be 'with you'?

St. Joseph, help me trust God like you. Amen.

Christmas
The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas Day)
John 1:1-18
"And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us..." (Jn 1:14)
Jesus Is Born!

The Word Became Flesh

"In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." Everything was made through Him. The Word is the light that shines in the darkness, and the darkness cannot overcome it. John the Baptist came to tell people about the light. At Christmas we celebrate that the Word became flesh and lived among us: Jesus, God's Son!

Christmas
The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
"Who arose, and took the child and his mother by night, and retired into Egypt..." (Mt 2:14)
Joseph Keeps Jesus Safe
An angel told Joseph, "Take Jesus and Mary to Egypt!" Joseph kept them safe. Later they came home to Nazareth.

The Holy Family Flees

After the wise men left, an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Rise, take the child and His mother, and flee to Egypt," the angel said, because King Herod wanted to harm Jesus. Joseph got up in the night and took them to Egypt. When Herod died, the angel told Joseph it was safe to go home. The Holy Family settled in Nazareth, where Jesus grew up.

The Epiphany of the Lord
Matthew 2:1-12
"...falling down they adored him: and opening their treasures, they offered him gifts..." (Mt 2:11)

The Magi Find the King

Wise men from the East came to Jerusalem asking, "Where is the newborn king of the Jews? We saw His star." King Herod was troubled and sent them to Bethlehem. The star went ahead of them and stopped over the place where the child was. They bowed down and worshiped Jesus, and gave Him gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Warned in a dream, they went home another way.

The Baptism of the Lord
Matthew 3:13-17
"This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased." (Mt 3:17)

Beloved Son

Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River to be baptized by John. John said, "I need to be baptized by You!" Jesus answered that it was right to do what God asks. When Jesus came up from the water, the heavens opened, and the Spirit of God came down like a dove. A voice from heaven said, "This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."
